outcome: Dendritic cell (DC) proportion in cord blood
Natural killer (NK) cell proportion in cord blood
CD56dimCD16+ NK cell proportion in cord blood
Incidence of small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: A cohort of 50 pregnant women diagnosed with idiopathic fetal growth restriction (IFGR) in their third trimester (28-36 weeks) and 50 healthy pregnant women as controls, from whom umbilical cord blood was collected at birth.
finding: The study found a significantly higher proportion of NK cells, specifically CD56dimCD16+ NK cells, and an imbalanced ratio of CD56dimCD16 + NK to CD56highCD16-NK in the umbilical cord blood of infants from IFGR pregnancies compared to healthy controls.
birth_weight: Newborns in the IFGR group had significantly lower birth weight compared to the control group, but specific weight criteria for inclusion are not mentioned.
gest_age: Mothers were recruited during the third trimester (28-36 weeks); 18% of births in the IFGR group were preterm.
